The topology works at tt. PSRR at 1 kHz misses by only 0.2 dB, and all the other specs pass. So I'll refine the parameters rather than edit the program.

PSRR at 1 kHz follows the loop gain at 1 kHz, which scales with the unity-gain frequency. Raising `r_ugf` should therefore close the gap. Ringing is at 8.6 mV against a 10 mV limit, so `r_zff` should rise too to add phase lead. There is about 7 µA of quiescent-current headroom for a little more `I_tail`.

```json
{"action": "refine",
 "reason": "Only PSRR@1kHz misses, by 0.2 dB, and all other specs pass. Raise the loop UGF (r_ugf) for more 1 kHz loop gain. Use Cff zero (r_zff) and pass-device sizing to hold phase margin and ringing. Use spare Iq headroom for I_tail/gm1. Topology is sound.",
 "params": {"r_ugf": 1.25, "r_zff": 1.3, "I_tail": 26e-6, "gmid_in": 19.0, "W_pass": 4800.0},
 "bounds": {"r_ugf": [1.0, 1.8], "r_zff": [0.7, 2.5], "I_tail": [20e-6, 28e-6], "I_div": [14e-6, 22e-6]}}
```
